patch_description: Add targeted observation goals when a remembered exit or door remains unreachable for four steps after collecting both keys. A counterfactual shortest-path search permits stale walls to reopen, including walls blocking diagonal corners, and identifies the first obstruction along a promising route. The agent then travels to a reachable viewpoint that reveals that obstruction. Actual movement retains the existing legality checks and learned hazard planner; hypothetical openings never modify terrain memory. Fresh observations invalidate obsolete recovery goals. This targets failed route recovery without changing ordinary exploration or predictive learning. Performance remains untested.
